notes.subject: כבוד
notes.rationale: כבוד em i 'weten/traipela nem', tasol ol tanim tok i usim 'bel/tong' — mi save senisim olsem 'kaikai bilong man' i no stret; stret tok: nem bilong mi

notes.subject: pronoun
notes.rationale: Hebrew i no gat pronaun bilong 'my glory'; Tok Pisin i nidim ⟨em⟩

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Devine man i toktok stret long Yahwe, Elohim bilong en

translation: Bilong dispela, olsem ⟨em⟩ i save senisim ⟨i⟩ kaikai bilong olgeta man bilong graun, olsem olgeta heven i save givim kaikai long graun — long taim ol i givim ⟨i⟩ ofa bilong paia long Yahwe.
